title: 2 Samuel Bible Quiz - Chapter 5
description: Ten questions on 2 Samuel 5: David is anointed king over all Israel, takes the stronghold of Zion, and defeats the Philistines.

questions.text: What did all the tribes of Israel say to David at Hebron?
questions.explanation: They said, "Behold, we are your bone and your flesh."

answers.text: "Give us a king like the nations"
"We are your bone and your flesh"

questions.text: What had Yahweh said David would be to his people Israel?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said to David, "You will be shepherd of my people Israel, and you will be prince over Israel."

questions.text: How old was David when he began to reign?
questions.explanation: David was thirty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years.

questions.text: What did the Jebusites say to David?
questions.explanation: The Jebusites said, "The blind and the lame will keep you out of here," thinking David could not come in.

answers.text: "The blind and the lame will keep you out of here"
"We will gladly give you the city in peace"
"Our high walls reach all the way up to heaven"
"The Philistines will come and save us"

questions.explanation: David took the stronghold of Zion, which is David's city.

questions.text: What did Hiram king of Tyre send to David?
questions.explanation: Hiram sent messengers with cedar trees, carpenters, and masons, and they built David a house.

questions.text: Which of these sons was born to David in Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: The sons born to David in Jerusalem include Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon.

questions.text: What did David say Yahweh had broken his enemies like at Baal Perazim?
questions.explanation: David said, "Yahweh has broken my enemies before me, like the breach of waters."

answers.text: Like dry straw in the fire
Like a reed in the wind

questions.text: What would David hear as the sign to attack in the second battle in the valley of Rephaim?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "When you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the mulberry trees, then stir yourself up."

answers.text: Fire falling from heaven on the camp
Marching in the tops of the mulberry trees
A trumpet sounding from the hills
A dark cloud settling over the valley

questions.text: How far did David strike the Philistines?
questions.explanation: David did as Yahweh commanded and struck the Philistines all the way from Geba to Gezer.
